cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 63% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.22% · WTI +2.95% · Brent -1.92% · NatGas +12.68%. 63% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +3.62%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Oilfield Services lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.62%; weakest is Oilfield Services at -2.18%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +17.04%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +17.04%, EOSE +6.32%, BE +4.87%, PWR +4.66%, ARRY +3.52%. Laggards: ENPH -16.33%, SEDG -8.98%, BKR -7.05%, NOV -6.16%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: ENPH moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: ENPH is -16.32% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
